For brokers and lenders: it reads every document, flags what's missing, inconsistent or expired, and validates the file before it reaches the bank — cutting hours of manual review and reducing back-and-forth.

records.name: NFC Studio
records.tagline: Read, Write, Secure NFC Tags
records.description: Read, write, secure, and manage NFC tags with ease. Complete product landing page for Android with interactive app showcase, feature deep-dives, and use cases.

records.name: EAN Studio
records.tagline: Design, verify & print barcodes and FNSKU labels in-browser
records.description: Generate 19 barcode formats, verify check digits, and design branded product labels — all in your browser. Print Amazon FNSKU labels in bulk from Excel, on thermal rolls or label sheets. Free generators & verifier, paid plans from €5/month.

records.name: Hirinfotech
records.tagline: Customer-Oriented Data Solutions
records.description: Hir Infotech delivers AI-driven web scraping and data analytics solutions. Extract valuable data, optimize decisions, and outperform competitors with ease.

records.name: Socioxplode— Post it. Debate it.
records.tagline: Post it.debate it.discover it
records.description: A late-night social platform for every idea: stories, theories, inventions, shower thoughts and ridiculous 2AM brainwaves.

records.name: AskMe
records.tagline: AI Support automation for digital products & communities
records.description: One AI support agent across Discord, Telegram, Slack, WhatsApp and your own website that learns from every resolved ticket. One dashboard, credits not seats. No code. Free to start.

records.name: Snowballer
records.tagline: See the month you're debt-free — then get there faster
records.description: Snowballer turns your debts into one payoff plan and puts the debt-free date on the scoreboard. Add balances, pick snowball or avalanche, log payments, and watch the date move. Try what-if extras before you commit. Payoff math is free; bank sync is optional Plus.

records.name: PleaseRepost
records.tagline: One-click LinkedIn resharing for teams.
records.description: Employee advocacy made simple. Every employee gets a unique reshare only link — one click, no chasing, no reminders.

records.name: ScriptFlow AI
records.tagline: One topic. A full campaign
records.description: Turn one video topic into a full script, an X thread, and a sponsorship cold email. Built for creators who want to create and monetize faster.

records.name: ThaiLang: Learn Thai Language
records.tagline: Thai Language Learning Application
records.description: Learn Thai Language on the Appstore!

records.name: Trackr TCG
records.tagline: The fastest Pokemon card scanner
records.description: Instant card scanning, real-time market prices, set completion tracking, and gradeable portfolios — built for Pokemon TCG collectors.
